fields.name: Model
fields.description: One of the available [TTS models](/docs/models#tts): `tts-1`, `tts-1-hd`, `gpt-4o-mini-tts`, or `gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15`.

fields.name: Input
fields.description: The text to generate audio for. The maximum length is 4096 characters.

fields.name: Instructions
fields.description: Control the voice of your generated audio with additional instructions. Does not work with `tts-1` or `tts-1-hd`.

fields.name: ResponseFormat
fields.description: The format to audio in. Supported formats are `mp3`, `opus`, `aac`, `flac`, `wav`, and `pcm`.

fields.name: Speed
fields.description: The speed of the generated audio. Select a value from `0.25` to `4.0`. `1.0` is the default.

fields.name: StreamFormat
fields.description: The format to stream the audio in. Supported formats are `sse` and `audio`. `sse` is not supported for `tts-1` or `tts-1-hd`.
